info.title: PHR Agent API
info.description: Versioned OAuth API for authorized PHR automation clients. Responses containing personal data are private and non-cacheable.

get.summary: Discover API operations, scopes, and limits
Get the authorized identity and granted scopes
List patients accessible to the authorized user

200.description: A cursor-bounded page of accessible patients

get.summary: Get one accessible patient and the caller's access metadata
Search concise records across core clinical resource types
List the patient timeline using the unified record projection
List explanation-of-benefit records without raw parser payloads
List bounded EOB service lines without raw parser payloads
List typed evidence links from one patient-scoped record

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: Document sources additionally require documents:read; other sources require clinical:read only.

post.description: The external identifier is namespaced to the OAuth client. Exact retries do not rewrite bytes, while changed bytes for the same identifier and same-client content-hash duplicates conflict.

post.summary: Create a one-minute signed download URL that still requires OAuth

get.summary: Download document bytes using OAuth plus an unexpired signature

post.summary: Idempotently enqueue structured extraction for a stored document

200.description: The document already has an import job

get.summary: Inspect an import job and its proposed records

post.summary: Safely retry a failed import job

200.description: The job is already queued or running

post.summary: Accept or reject one proposed import record
post.description: Write-only tokens receive a mutation-safe result receipt. Full extracted proposal data additionally requires imports:read.

get.summary: List one core clinical resource type for an accessible patient

200.description: A cursor-bounded page of clinical records

put.summary: Idempotently create or update an office visit
put.description: Stable external IDs are namespaced to the authenticated OAuth client. A changed existing record requires its current opaque version; an already-applied retry remains safe with a stale version.

200.description: Existing record updated or desired state already present

put.summary: Idempotently create or update a procedure
put.description: Stable external IDs are namespaced to the authenticated OAuth client. A changed existing record requires its current opaque version; an already-applied retry remains safe with a stale version.

200.description: Existing record updated or desired state already present

get.summary: Get one core clinical record for an accessible patient

post.summary: Exchange MCP Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC messages
post.description: MCP tools are thin adapters over the REST operations in this specification. Request bodies are limited to 262144 bytes. Tool calls additionally require each underlying REST operation's scope.

200.description: MCP JSON-RPC response or event stream

413.description: MCP request body exceeds the configured size limit

delete.summary: Immediately revoke the current access token and its refresh token

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code with S256 PKCE. Access tokens expire after 15 minutes and refresh tokens rotate on use.

scopes.identity:read: Read account identity and granted scopes
scopes.patients:read: List and read patients you can access
scopes.clinical:read: Read clinical records for patients you can access
scopes.clinical:write: Create and update clinical records you can manage
scopes.documents:read: Read document metadata and download authorized files
scopes.imports:read: Read import jobs and extraction results
scopes.mcp:use: Connect through the PHR MCP server

ReviewStatus.name: review_status
ReviewStatus.description: Matches office-visit/procedure review_status or condition/allergy verification_status; other types cannot match this filter.

ImportSource.name: import_source
ImportSource.description: Exact provenance-source filter; prohibited for health logs.

SourceDocumentId.name: source_document_id
SourceDocumentId.description: Exact source-document filter; prohibited for health logs.

Archived.name: archived
Archived.description: Patient and health-log archival filter. Prohibited for other clinical resources.

LocalDateTime.description: Application-local datetime in the existing PHR JSON wire format; no timezone offset is implied.

version.description: Present on agent-writable resource types and required to change an existing record.

Eob.description: Privacy-minimized EOB metadata. Raw text, parser data, member identifiers, tax identifiers, check numbers, and user identifiers are never returned.

external_id.description: Null when the internal deduplication key embeds a source-document content hash.

EobLine.description: EOB line without raw parser payloads.

DocumentMetadata.description: Document metadata without storage keys, hashes, extracted text, or user identifiers.

external_id.description: Null when the internal deduplication key embeds a source-document content hash.

file.description: PDF, image, text, or HTML; at most 50 MiB.

data.description: Full metadata is returned only when the token also has documents:read; otherwise this is a mutation-safe receipt.

payload.description: Optional corrected proposal for accept only; prohibited for reject.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, expired, or revoked bearer token

InsufficientScope.description: The token does not grant the required scope

Conflict.description: The supplied stable identity conflicts with existing state, or a mutable record requires its current version

NotFound.description: Patient, resource, or record was not found within the caller's access boundary

InvalidRequest.description: A filter, limit, or cursor is invalid
